metadata.question: Did more forest area burn in Sakha in 2015 than compared to 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about forest burned area comparison between 2015 and 2021 in Sakha (a republic in Russia). I need to: 1. Find appropriate burned area data - MODIS burned area product (MCD64A1) would be good 2. Define Sakha region geometry 3. Filter for forest areas using land cover data 4. Compare burned area between 2015 and 2021 5. Handle potential data issues Let me break this down: - Use MODIS MCD64A1 burned area product - Use MODIS MCD12Q1 land cover to identify forest areas - Define Sakha region as a polygon - Calculate total burned forest area for 2015 and 2021 - Compare the two years I need to be careful about: - Checking for empty collections - Validating pixel counts after masking - Ensuring the calculation produces valid numbers - Using appropriate scale to avoid memory issues ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Sakha region (Yakutia) as a polygon var sakha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[105, 50], [165, 50], [165, 75], [105, 75], [105, 50]] ]); // Define time periods var start2015 = '2015-01-01'; var end2015 = '2015-12-31'; var start2021 = '2021-01-01'; var end2021 = '2021-12-31'; // Load MODIS burned area product var burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1'); // Load MODIS land cover for forest classification var landcover2015 = ee.Image('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1/2015_01_01').select('LC_Type1'); var landcover2021 = ee.Image('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1/2021_01_01').select('LC_Type1'); // Forest classes in IGBP classification: 1-5 (evergreen, deciduous, mixed, closed, open) var forestMask2015 = landcover2015.gte(1).and(landcover2015.lte(5)); var forestMask2021 = landcover2021.gte(1).and(landcover2021.lte(5)); // Get burned area for 2015 and 2021 var burned2015 = burnedArea.filterDate(start2015, end2015).filterBounds(sakha); var burned2021 = burnedArea.filterDate(start2021, end2021).filterBounds(sakha); // Check if collections are empty var count2015 = burned2015.size().getInfo(); var count2021 = burned2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${count2015}, 2021 Images: ${count2021}`); if (count2015 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create annual composites and mask to forest areas var burnedForest2015 = burned2015.max().updateMask(forestMask2015).select('BurnDate'); var burnedForest2021 = burned2021.max().updateMask(forestMask2021).select('BurnDate'); // Count burned pixels (BurnDate > 0 indicates burned) var burnedPixels2015 = burnedForest2015.gt(0); var burnedPixels2021 = burnedForest2021.gt(0); // Calculate total burned area in hectares (500m resolution, each pixel = 25ha) var reducer = ee.Reducer.sum(); var scale = 1000; var area2015 = burnedPixels2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: sakha, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); var area2021 = burnedPixels2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: sakha, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); // Get pixel counts for validation var count2015Valid = burnedPixels2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sakha, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); var count2021Valid = burnedPixels2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sakha, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); var area2015Val = area2015.getInfo(); var area2021Val = area2021.getInfo(); var count2015ValidVal = count2015Valid.getInfo(); var count2021ValidVal = count2021Valid.getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Burned Pixels: ${area2015Val}, Valid Pixels: ${count2015ValidVal}`); console.log(`2021 Burned Pixels: ${area2021Val}, Valid Pixels: ${count2021ValidVal}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2015ValidVal === 0 || count2021ValidVal === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (area2015Val === null || area2021Val === null || isNaN(area2015Val) || isNaN(area2021Val)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare burned areas if (area2015Val > area2021Val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
